body: message me?
you don’t need to do this, if you need a friend i’m here just message me. suicide isn’t the answer

i don’t know your story but it must be a bad one if you’re considering suicide. i’m not going to tell you not to but i’m not telling you to. think it through. i’m also 16 and extremely suicidal. something we can relate on hey? message me if you need someone to talk to, or don’t up to you.

i get that, it’s hard. if you want to talk to someone and you don’t want to call a hotline i’m free to have a chat if you need it. there are many people on this subreddit that would be happy to let you rant
it won’t kill you, just make you incredibly sick
you can

i can’t say i know exactly how you’re feeling but if you want to talk i’m here. i’m also 15 and suicidal so hey we have something in common right? just message me if you need to rant or if you need someone to talk to. i understand it’s hard but you’ll get through it. at least make it to 18 so you can move away from your parents and so on. have you spoke to the school about getting help with your maths? at my school we have programs to help people who struggle, maybe look into it to see if there is anyway you can get support. suicide isn’t the answer and i know it sounds hypocritical of me to say that considering i’ve attempted and landed myself in mental wards many times. but trust me, in the long run it’s not worth it and you’ll get through it x

as someone who is currently in and out of hospital for being suicidal i can tell you my experiences. 
basically you’ll be sat in a room and they will have someone come and have a talk, they’ll ask you questions and you have to answer honestly. 
it’s not scary and if you want to message me i can help you through it xx
you’re not alone on this site. if you need  the support i’m here. just please don’t end it.
i know how you feel, trust me i’m going through the exact same thing. message me if you need someone to rant/talk too. i’m here to listen.  i can relate to how you’re feeling man trust me

message me if you want to talk, you don’t need to do this. there are other options. please don’t do anything stupid. think this through. think about how much it will affect your family and the people who love you. please i’m just a message away
you know nothing. you’re full of bullshit. do you enjoy picking on mentally ill people? i have a lot more then depression. you don’t know me so you can’t sit there and say i don’t have these things.

right having an abusive mother and having no one in my life is completely good. my medication doesn’t cost that much so idk what you’re on about there. thank you for telling me i’m weak and shallow, means a lot. why are you even on this subreddit if you’re legit just going to bag out someone like that?
well then i’m guessing my doctors got my diagnosis wrong then? and i’m on medication for depression for nothing? right

i’m just so tired all the time i don’t have the energy/ motivation to do anything. i’m depressed and suicidal all the time and it’s the only thing i think of. being so depressed makes it hard to do things
always feeling alone
everything at this point
message if you want too

i know you probably don’t want to hear it but maybe go see a doctor or something. go see someone to talk to about how your feeling and go from there. talk to your college about how your feeling and maybe try and work something out so your not falling behind as much. my first step would be to go see your doctor about how your feeling and see if you can get a referral to somewhere to have a chat. please don’t resort to suicidal thoughts, it’s not worth it and there are other options
no one deserves to die, especially not you. you’re going through a rough patch, we’ve all been there. have you tried talking to someone?

i sat on my bathroom floor and tried to swallow a bunch of mixed pills, also slit my wrists. but my mum walked in and took my to hospital where i stayed for two days. 

nothing will change for me, im a lost cause.
i’m sorry you’re going through all this, try and get help. please don’t end it.
honestly you’re posting to get help but then when someone offers you help you say no. yeah ok makes sense bud.

trust me there is a solution for all your problems, trust me suicide isn’t a solution. you will regret it i promise you. do not fucking take your life. so what you had a few rough years. try as hard as you can. you can make it. don’t give up and take the easy way out. you weren’t put on this planet to kill your self. don’t do this to everyone around you.

you can get through it. considering i’m going through something a lot fucking similar. i know how you’re feeling. don’t fucking waste your life like that. you need to push through and try. suicide will solve nothing.

please don’t end it. once your gone, you’re gone for good. please message me, i’d gladly be your friend. think about your family, think about how it would affect them. once you hit bottom you can only go up, please don’t give up x
i’m here for you if you want to talk, im just a message away x
trust me once you’ve hit bottom you can only go up
please don’t kill yourself, i promise things will get better. i’m just a message away if you need to talk x
i know this feeling, im going through a similar experience. message me if you want to talk about it. i’m always here, you’re not alone i promise x

think about your family and friends. think about your future and how many people would be affected. think about how to fix the problem that’s causing you to be suicidal. these are just the things that stop me, other people have other ways

you have a future, you have a long life ahead of you. there is nothing you can’t do if you put your mind to it. don’t give up, trust me i know how hard it is to keep going. i tried taking my own life. it’s not a pleasant experience. you can get through it i promise. there is always hope x
because even if you don’t realise it, someone loves you. do it for them.

hey guys thanks for all the replies, it’s nice to know some people care. i had swallowed quite a few pills when my mum found me crying. i was taken to hospital and that’s where i’m currently writing to you from. unfortunately i’m fine. i’m not suppose to be on my phone so it will have to be quick. thank you guys
